verdict.rationale: Mem0 explicitly supports headless usage: agents can self-provision an API key with four terminal commands with no email or dashboard (mem0-docs-17, mem0-docs-45, mem0-docs-40), and the platform exposes a REST API/OpenAPI spec (mem0-probe-2) plus a CLI (mem0-docs-14, mem0-docs-34, mem0-docs-59) and Python/JS SDKs (mem0-docs-25, mem0-docs-35) for scripted add/search operations. Self-hosted Docker deployment with per-user API keys and audit logs (mem0-docs-22, mem0-docs-28, mem0-docs-54) further supports non-interactive, automatable operation suitable for CI pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), independent hands-on verification of headless automation workflows.
